subject: Order arrived damaged - tea gift box
body: Hi, I ordered a tea gift box from your Beijing Chaoyang store last week and it arrived today. The outer box was fine but when I opened it, the gift box inside was crushed on one corner and a couple of the tea tins were dented. This was supposed to be a gift for a friend's birthday this weekend, so I'm pretty disappointed. I already called the store earlier and the person I spoke to said to email with photos, so I've attached a few. I'd really like to get this sorted before Saturday if possible. Thanks.
